title: Glass Frogs find harmony in chaos with a soulful groove “Unbalanced”
htmlContent: There's something wonderfully authentic about feeling a bit off balance, and Glass Frogs perfectly captures that feeling in their latest song, "Unbalanced." Blending classic funk vibes reminiscent of Sly & The Family Stone, the track is incredibly smooth with the sleek styles of modern pop and neo-soul. The music flows easily, allowing the rich keyboards, solid bass, and skillfully placed guitar riffs to express the song's emotional depth. The vocals share the song's core message with genuine honesty, guiding listeners through the ups and downs of mental struggles. "Unbalanced" is about dealing with challenges and finding relief. The melody brings a sense of freedom, and the harmonies wrap around the words like a comforting embrace. https://open.spotify.com/track/6omhBPwOjosteJEi4u5zTO?si=yZ6AlooyQACn7BdLemI49Q It's a song that lets you feel your emotions without becoming overwhelmed. By mixing the gritty elements of classic funk with a fresh, modern soulfulness, Glass Frogs create a tune that feels comforting and excitingly new. "Unbalanced" is a celebration of life's imperfections and a reminder that even when things get messy, there's always music to help you move forward. Follow on: Instagram/TikTok
